text:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy STARTED for routing-service -> production · canary=5% · tag=v1.12.3 · commit=0a3f9c7
Initiated by: alice

alice: Kicking off smoke checks. I'll watch p95 and error-rate for the next 10m.

ben: I'll keep an eye on error budget and traces, ping if anything >0.5% 5xx.

carla: Added canary routing rule to service config (traffic-split=5/95).

deploy-bot: Canary progress · elapsed=1m · healthy=true · error-rate=0.0% · p95=120ms

emily: Heads up I'm seeing a small 5xx blip on one canary pod in logs, posting snippet.

emily: ```
ERROR db/conn.go:87 timeout connecting to primary-db: context deadline exceeded
stack: db/conn -> pool.get -> net.dial
```

ben: Confirmed from traces: a single canary pod returned ~30 5xx in 30s, appears to be DB timeouts.

alice: Scaling canary down to 2% while we triage. Don't want full canary to blow up.

deploy-bot: Canary update · traffic=2% · healthy=false · error-rate=1.8% · action=paused

carla: Looking into DB metrics — increased connection wait and a small reconnect backlog on that AZ. Might be a transient DB maintenance window.

alice: We should be conservative. Decision: PAUSE and ROLLBACK the canary to previous stable tag to avoid user impact. @oncall please monitor.

deploy-bot: Initiating canary rollback -> rolling back routing-service to tag=v1.12.2 · commit=ff22334

ci-bot: rollback job queued (job #1298) · runner=prod-ops-3 · ETA ~90s

deploy-bot: Canary rollback COMPLETE · environment=production · tag=v1.12.2 · duration=4m32s

ben: Good call. We'll hold v1.12.3 until root cause fixed. Suggest creating a hotfix branch from 0a3f9c7 and add retries/timeouts for DB pool.

carla: I opened PR #452 to add a socket timeout and better DB retry logic. Also added a short healthcheck to avoid promoting if DB latency >200ms.

alice: Noting for release notes: "Canary for v1.12.3 paused and rolled back due to DB timeouts observed in canary pods; holding v1.12.3 until patch validated."

alice: Next steps: pin prod routing-service to v1.12.2, create hotfix from 0a3f9c7, run unit+smoke in CI, verify in staging, then rerun canary at 1% for 15m with close monitoring.

oncall-bot: @alice acknowledged · monitoring enabled on routing-service · dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/routing-service

deploy-bot: Promotion aborted · canary not promoted · reason=health-check-failed

emily: Thanks all — I'll take the PR and run the patch validation tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:

alice: Adding incident note to the release board and marking v1.12.3 as held until PR #452 validated.
